_comment: Seven beats in the order the capture journey expects (web/video/capture-production.mjs). captionText is what a judge reads on screen and carries the exact figures. speechText is the same sentence spelled for a text to speech engine, so AWS becomes A W S and EU becomes E U. Run video/generate-narration.py once and read the total it prints before planning around any length: it refuses outside 90 to 174 seconds and tells you the measured figure. Record only after GET /healthz on the live URL reports live_model true and the released commit.

segments._beat: The problem, in the words of the person who has it. The landing page is on screen: the H1 and the sample repair card.
segments.captionText: Elena Georgiou's washing machine failed 22 months after purchase, and the repair cost 185 EUR. The receipt, the repair invoice and the seller's address live in three places, and nobody keeps the case together. Hestia starts from that receipt and asks Elena to approve the exact notice; nothing is sent.
segments.speechText: Elena Georgiou's washing machine failed twenty-two months after purchase, and the repair cost one hundred and eighty-five euros. The receipt, the repair invoice and the seller's address live in three places, and nobody keeps the case together. Hestia starts from that receipt and asks Elena to approve the exact notice; nothing is sent.

segments._beat: One click on the landing button creates the demo space; Home opens at the top with the Start here block and the review card.
segments.captionText: One click on the landing page opens a private demo space with a fictional Athens household: no account, no login, a 30-minute limit. Home starts with three ways to add your own records, then shows what needs a decision this week: the recorded repair, a trial ending, a price change from 9.99 to 13.99 EUR, and a receipt missing for 85.50 EUR.
segments.speechText: One click on the landing page opens a private demo space with a fictional Athens household: no account, no login, a thirty-minute limit. Home starts with three ways to add your own records, then shows what needs a decision this week: the recorded repair, a trial ending, a price change from nine ninety-nine to thirteen ninety-nine euros, and a receipt missing for eighty-five euros fifty.

segments._beat: The Strands agent runs. The briefing, the mode chips and the opened tool trace are on screen.
segments.captionText: Ask Hestia to review this household, and a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock reads the records through four tools: repair evidence, subscriptions, receipts and utilities, and the case timeline. It writes a short briefing that points at decisions; a guard withholds the whole briefing if it claims an entitlement or states an amount the tools did not return. The tool trace stays visible.

segments._beat: The flagship claim on the anonymous live path: the exact notice is reviewed and approved, recorded and not sent.
segments.captionText: Then Hestia stops. The notice to Kotsovolos Megastore is prepared on the server from the recorded facts: recipient, subject, the 185 EUR repair cost and the exact text. Elena reads it and approves it with a single-use token bound to that exact draft. The approval is recorded as a simulation. No email is sent.

segments._beat: The saved case timeline is on screen while the narration names what is load-bearing on AWS.
segments.captionText: The saved case now carries the draft, the approval and the next step; every reply, deadline or outcome Elena records later stays on that timeline. Remove AWS and the product stops: the Strands Agents SDK runs Claude Haiku 4.5 through Amazon Bedrock inside Lambda, and Amazon S3 conditional writes keep every case revision consistent.

segments._beat: The About page with the mode list and the read-only console showing the live health check.
segments.captionText: Every claim is checkable without asking us. The About page lists what runs and what does not: bank feeds, mailbox sync, receipt OCR, Guardrails, AgentCore and email sending are not connected. Its read-only console returns the live health check with the model limits: 3 reviews and 3 text readings per demo space, 200 a day shared by both. Independent human testing is reported as not run.
